keyFindings.title: All ten skill-shaped controls keep their incumbent skill
Controls contain generic verbs a careless phrase set could collide with
A pre-existing system-deep-loop/sk-code ambiguity exists at 0.95/0.95
Six candidate doctor phrases already route to their owning skill
Three candidate phrases are empty today and safe as first-wave additions
Two candidate phrases currently mis-route and adoption would correct them
Verbatim phrase duplication produces ties and ambiguity, not handoff
Incumbent diagnostic routes sit at 0.82-0.95 confidence, so doctor phrases will clear the gate
Arbitration guard set: phrase ownership, diagnostic 3+ token phrases, empty-first, control re-run, ambiguity budget
The 0.08 command demotion is too small to serve as a theft guard
